items.name: Tata Steel Limited
items.headline: Tata Steel to sell tubes, pipes business and Tata Steel Colors to APL Apollo for Rs 28,000 crore
items.brief: Tata Steel approved the sale of its steel tubes and pipes business to APL Apollo Tubes for Rs 11,700 crore. The company also agreed to sell its entire stake in Tata Steel Colors for Rs 16,300 crore.

items.name: APL Apollo Tubes Limited
items.headline: APL Apollo Tubes: Acquisition (including agreement to acquire)
items.brief: APL APOLLO TUBES LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding Acquisition (including agreement to acquire)

items.name: Ashok Leyland Limited
items.headline: Ashok Leyland expands EV push with order of 200 trucks for cement transport, eyes wider LCV market
items.brief: The order marks Ashok Leyland subsidiary OHM Mobility’s expansion beyond electric buses into freight transportation, a segment seen as the next growth frontier for commercial vehicle electrification

items.name: Adani Energy Solutions Limited
items.headline: Adani Energy Solutions bags 2,500 MW renewable power supply contract from West Bengal discom
items.brief: The latest win comes as AESL expands its presence in India’s power transmission segment, having secured a major transmission project in Bihar

items.name: Punjab National Bank
items.headline: PNB needs Rs 5,000 crore extra provisions under ECL, CEO sees limited impact
items.brief: Punjab National Bank expects an additional provision of approximately Rs 5,000 crore due to ECL migration. They initially estimated higher but reduced the expected requirement based on digital assessments.

items.name: IndusInd Bank Limited
items.headline: IndusInd Bank ends ex-CEO Kathpalia's employment, seeks to recover pay
items.brief: IndusInd Bank has ended the employment of Sumant Kathpalia following a disciplinary investigation into misconduct. After misreporting accounting details led to significant financial losses, disciplinary proceedings were initiated against him.

items.name: Lodha Developers Limited
items.headline: Lodha Developers Chairman Mukund Chitale Steps Down; Akhil Gupta To Replace
items.brief: Mukund Chitale also completed his tenure as independent director.

items.name: Hero MotoCorp Limited
items.headline: Hero MotoCorp gets tribunal relief on Rs 27 crore income tax demand
items.brief: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal has provided significant relief to Hero MotoCorp regarding an income tax demand. The outstanding demand amount was reduced to approximately Rs 27 crore across six assessment years.

items.name: Aurobindo Pharma Limited
items.headline: US drug regulator classifies Aurobindo Pharma arm's Andhra facility as 'voluntary action indicated'
items.brief: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has announced that its subsidiary, Apitoria Pharma Pvt Ltd, received a VAI classification for its facility. The classification indicates that some objectionable conditions were found, but no regulatory actions will occur.

items.name: Voltas Limited
items.headline: Voltas signs joint venture agreement with Atomberg Innovation, to hold 50% stake in entity — All we know
items.brief: Voltas has executed a joint venture agreement with Atomberg Innovation for the development, manufacture and commercialisation of room air-conditioner compressors, the air conditioner maker informed the exchanges.

items.name: Patanjali Foods Limited
items.headline: Patanjali Foods faces fresh cow ghee safety action as Madhya Pradesh bans sale of one batch. Details inside
items.brief: Patanjali Foods has said it will seek retesting and may appeal after Madhya Pradesh authorities banned the sale of a cow ghee batch declared unsafe.

items.name: Railtel Corporation Of India Limited
items.headline: Railtel Corporation Of India: Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
items.brief: Railtel Corporation Of India Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts

items.name: Titan Company Limited
items.headline: Titan to expand premium watch business, target 500 Helios stores in three years
items.brief: Titan, which currently operates around 316 stores under its Helios and Helios Luxe formats, plans to add 40-50 stores annually, including premium Helios Luxe outlets, said Rahul Shukla, Vice President and Chief Sales and Marketing Officer, Watches Division, Titan Company Ltd.

items.name: Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited
items.headline: Aditya Birla Real Estate aims Rs 15,000 crore annual pre-sales in three years
items.brief: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd has set an ambitious target of achieving Rs 15,000 crore in annual pre-sales. The company recorded sales bookings of over Rs 8,000 crore during the past two financial years.

items.name: Maruti Suzuki India Limited
items.headline: Maruti Suzuki hikes select model prices amid cost pressures
items.brief: The latest price hike follows three rounds of price increases in the first half of financial year 2027, totalling a little over 1 per cent.

items.name: ITC Limited
items.headline: ITC extends Braille-enabled packaging to Fiama, takes total to 16 SKUs
items.brief: Alongside an industry-wide shift toward AI-enabled personalisation and algorithmic optimisation, diversified conglomerate ITC Ltd is pursuing an analogue, inclusive approach to product innovation by incorporating raised Braille text on select personal care items from its Savlon and Fiama portfolios.

items.name: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited
items.headline: Rail Vikas Nigam: Updates
items.brief: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Rail Vikas Nigam Limited emerges as the Lowest Bidder (L1) from East Coast Railway-Normal course of business of the Company.'.

items.name: Indian Oil Corporation Limited
items.headline: Reliance, Indian Oil, other Indian refiners race to secure oil tankers as freight costs rise
items.brief: Indian refiners are increasingly looking for long-term tanker contracts to secure crude supplies effectively. The ongoing disruptions in the Persian Gulf have led to rising freight costs and tighter vessel availability.

items.name: Vedanta Limited
items.headline: Vedanta to pay 10% salary to 1 lakh employees under Chairman Grant
items.brief: The grant, which covers employees from entry-level positions to mid and senior management, is aimed at providing additional financial support to employees and their families amid rising living costs.

items.name: Radico Khaitan Limited
items.headline: Johnnie Walker-owner overtakes Pernod Ricard as India's largest alco-bev firm; Radico Khaitan in 3rd place
items.brief: Pernod Ricard India reported a significant revenue decline of 13.6% in FY26, primarily due to the sale of Imperial Blue. Consequently, the company lost its status as the largest alcoholic beverage player to Diageo India.
